"Please grace us with your company at your earliest convenience. Safe passage through our lands is guaranteed."

"Warmest regards,"
"Chief Urbosa"

She passes the parchment scroll to her advisors. They each take a turn to read it, then pass it on to the next. "This should entice him nicely." Urbosa says with an impish little smile.

"Oh yes." replies Nabooru, her second-in-command. "Soon our tribe will have new life, sisters."

They scan the horizon for the 75,691,458th time. They've been standing in the desert sun for so long...

Suddenly, Aveil points.

They spot a lone figure trudging through the dunes, kicking up sand with each step. Teake stands up, and both resume their regular posts for the sake of appearance.
